personaSeed: You are a careful academic researcher. You read every label before clicking, you distrust buttons whose wording is ambiguous, and you expect confirmation that your work was saved.

findings.summary: The product crashed mid-session and stayed unreachable (ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED on every page) for over 10 minutes of retries, ending the session entirely. It went down immediately after ordinary navigation (clicking a task card, then opening a project board).

There is no single place to clear the waiting items. The Deck — the only page framed as the queue for 'when your AI agents need your input' — shows 'No pending decisions' while a design approval sits in the Priority Matrix, a task verdict sits under a project's Verify tab, and no brief is visible anywhere. A user told 'several things are waiting' finds an empty Deck.

The verdict cannot be spot-checked: the verification page shows only the word 'Error' with a timestamp — no verdict content, no criteria, no approve/reject controls — and its Timeline/other tabs show nothing extra. The Runs page reveals verification runs repeatedly failing with 'Harness malfunction — not a verdict — verification exited 1'.

The design-approval task ('Review and approve landing page design', assigned to me) cannot be acted on: clicking its card in the Priority Matrix does nothing — no detail view, no approve/request-changes controls appear, despite the card text saying 'Approve or request changes.'
Answered decision cards on the Deck are inert — clicking one does nothing — so there is no way to review an answer's detail or take a decision back after it has been answered.

On first visit the Deck rendered completely blank (only a breadcrumb, with the sidebar degraded to 'Governor offline'); a manual reload was required to see any content. Background requests for project briefs returned 404 on the same load.

No 'brief' is findable anywhere in the product (project pages, Library, search), even though the app itself requests project briefs in the background and gets 404s — so a stale brief waiting on the user is invisible.

Global search for 'approve' does not find the 'Review and approve landing page design' task; it returns unrelated fuzzy matches (e.g. brain-dump notes and an unrelated mission), so search cannot route a user to their own pending approval.

Every page load logs a React hydration-mismatch error in the console, and background API calls intermittently fail (404 on /api/projects/*/brief, 405 on /api/dashboard, aborted /api/tasks and /api/sidebar).
